evidence_basis: Question: what Sax 2022 says about quetiapine, amorolfine and clobetasol. Quetiapine inhibits EBP in the authors' OPC assays (cell sterol profiling, no biochemical EBP assay on quetiapine); amorolfine acts on sterol 14-reductase in OPCs; clobetasol is the only compound with no cholesterol-pathway inhibition among the re-evaluated Najm hits.
